rv.q: This is a brilliant and well-written musical that covers a lot of plot into just an hour.

It’s a stuffed play, which sometimes means the details are as lightly drawn as Fraser Lappin’s simple set, which consists of some cardboard cut-outs depicting bowling pins, neon signs and a geolocation point over Dundee.
There is charm aplenty in Dyson and Kelly's quirky tale of an innocent abroad whose world is turned upside down before she finds her feet again.

cn.t: This charming new musical earns praise for its garishly madcap sensibility and winning performances, particularly from co-creator Taylor Dyson, as it tells a heartfelt story set in an Inverness bowling alley.
